text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I greet Air Groove as she returns from
her
awe-inspiring performance in the
Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As expected from the Oka Sho, the
competition
was spectacularly fierce.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Races like this truly do set my heart
alight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race has just finished, but Air
Groove is
ablaze with fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: We'll have to show an even better run at the Oaks than today.
You'll have to show an even better run at the Oaks than today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back. I want to go over today's
race and
start strategizing for the
Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Oaks is coming up fast.
We can't
afford to rest on our laurels!
